rows.role_title: Председатель Правительства — Chairman of the Government
rows.text: Under Article 83(a) of the Constitution the President appoints Vladimir Vladimirovich Putin Chairman of the Government of the Russian Federation; in force on signing. Signed "Президент Российской Федерации Д.Медведев", Moscow, Kremlin, 8 May 2008, No. 723.
